canonical_project: IOKWE / Bulikula subsea cable Ebeye landing
owner: Google with Marshall Islands National Telecommunications Authority and Pacific partners
notes: Telecom edge/cable landing infrastructure, not a commercial data center. DCD and SubTel Forum reported that IOKWE will connect Majuro and Ebeye in the Marshall Islands to Google's Bulikula/Halaihai Pacific cable system; public reporting did not give capacity or a completed in-service date.
